description: Retrieve a hotel prebook by its `prebookId`: final price, cancellation terms, room details and the `checkoutUrl` (`https://book.maqami.co/booking?prebookId=...`). Bookings are paid and confirmed only on MAQAMI's website, through the `checkoutUrl`.

prebookId.description: (Required) The unique identifier of the prebook session.

name: get_prebooks_prebookid
title: Get locked hotel rate
